name: Tianyuornis
sum: Toothed hongshanornithid from lake deposits of the Yixian Formation in Inner Mongolia.
holotype: A skeleton from the Yixian Formation (number in Zheng et al. 2014).
biology: Its teeth confirm that hongshanornithids were toothed.
author: Zheng et al. 2014
